claim: The maximum air temperature in Warsaw on 2026-08-30 (UTC day) will be above 25.7°C.
resolution_criterion: YES if the value at JSON pointer /daily/temperature_2m_max/0 in the Open-Meteo response for latitude 52.23, longitude 21.01, start_date=2026-08-30, end_date=2026-08-30, timezone=UTC is strictly greater than 25.7. NO otherwise. The threshold was set to the forecast value published for 2026-08-30 at the time of writing, so the honest probability is close to a half. This is a canary: it is unscored and exists to exercise the pipeline daily.
